speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of tics and current use of haloperidol, I need to check for signs of Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome. Do you have any muscle rigidity, sweating, or rapid changes in your heart rate or blood pressure? REQUEST TEST: Creatine Kinase

text: Your significantly elevated creatine kinase, combined with fever, altered mentation, and haloperidol use, strongly points to Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome. I need to assess your vital signs for autonomic instability; do you have a rapid heart rate or unstable blood pressure?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever and altered mentation. I also have Profuse sweating, Generalized rigidity, Confusion and disorientation, Ability to move all limbs, Normal deep tendon reflexes with bilateral downgoing plantar responses.

speaker: Doctor
text: Your symptoms of fever, altered mentation, profuse sweating, and generalized rigidity, along with the elevated creatine kinase and haloperidol use, are classic for Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome.
